title: unified-rollouts: canary + A/B + shadow automated rollback workflows and stability guards
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: rollout automation needs stronger end-to-end safety guards across canary, A/B, and shadow modes to reduce regression blast radius and to enable fast safe rollouts. This PR implements: 1) a unified workflow controller that sequences staged canary, weighted A/B, and shadow probing steps with configurable metric thresholds and cooldowns; 2) automatic rollback orchestration driven by composite metric evaluators (latency p95, error rate, model-diff quality regression score) with backoff and alerting hooks; 3) stability guards to prevent overlapping experiments and to enforce global SLAs; 4) observability additions (per-stage metrics, rollout traces, and rollout-level events) and e2e tests for common failure modes. Checklist: - [x] design doc linked and reviewed (ENG-2142) - [x] workflow controller implementation - [x] composite metric evaluator and policy engine - [x] canary/AB/shadow stage definitions + sampling adapters - [x] automatic rollback and recovery handlers - [x] tracing and rollout-level telemetry - [x] unit + integration + e2e tests - [x] docs and example rollout CRs Changeset summary: the change touches the rollout controller, scheduler, policy engine, metric evaluators, admission checks, and observability pipelines. Backwards compatibility: rollout CRs are additive; old fields are honored for backwards compatibility. Migration notes: new fields available in rollout spec; operator can enable "autorollback" flag per rollout. Testing notes: added integration harness tests that exercise metric regressions and simulate traffic spikes causing rollbacks. Related: builds on prior work in pr-61234 and pr-70215 and addresses SUP-5421 incident follow-up.
commits: 7 commits: add workflow controller core loop; implement composite metric evaluator; add sampling adapters for shadow probes; autorollback handlers + retries; expose rollout traces to observability pipeline; add e2e tests for staged rollouts; docs and examples
review_comments: Ibrahim: left a request to tighten timeout handling in the controller loop and to add a unit test for the evaluator edge case where metrics are missing; Lucas: suggested converting one of the internal maps to a typed struct for clarity; Priya: asked for clearer rollout event names and a note in the docs about enabling autorollback in Dedicated clusters. Author replies: addressed timeouts and added test; refactored map to typed struct; clarified event naming and added a warning about operator permissions. Final review: approved by all reviewers after CI green and e2e pass.
release_notes: Add unified rollout workflows with automatic rollback policies and enhanced observability. Operators can opt-in to autorollback per rollout. Includes new sample CRs and e2e tests.
notes_for_ops: When enabling autorollback in Dedicated/Private deployments ensure rollout-controller has access to observability read APIs and the operator grants rollout-controller permission to modify traffic routing resources. See docs/unified-rollouts.md for details.
regressions_simulated: Simulated regressions include increased token-latency p95, synthetic error spikes, and quality drift measured via embedding-based similarity checks; policies triggered clean rollback in tests.
testing_summary: Added unit tests for policy engine, integration tests for staged canary and weighted A/B, and e2e harness simulations for shadow probing and rollback scenarios. All tests added to CI pipeline.
